description: A Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, partitioning, and layout management.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block_size greater than or equal to given length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry and returns its components or terminates on invalid data.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Locates the partition table within firmware data if present.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table into an array of partition component arrays.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates trailer data (not used currently).

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints contents of the RedBoot trailer from firmware data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition info based on firmware buffer and partition table.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds binary partition table data from partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles and writes the complete firmware image from partitions.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity checks partition table data.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints human-readable partition information.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns default partition layout.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates start offsets and sizes for partitions based on layout rules.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads firmware image from file and populates partitions.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes partition data to files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from files into memory.
